decisions.reason: The source explicitly limits automatic product-type population to TikTok; it does not change the Shopify website listing process.
Automatic population of TikTok's product-type field does not change which products the spreadsheet tracks or the requirement to record sourced products.
The TikTok listing-field behavior does not alter CJ product sourcing or the evidence used to select products.
The Google Drive social content bank is unrelated to automatic population of a TikTok Shop product-listing field.
The source concerns a TikTok Shop catalog field and does not change daily social-post scheduling, publishing cadence, or publishing contexts.
